title: checkpointwithoutuse_reentrantshould raise an exception
bug_description:
According to [this](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/v2.8.0/torch/utils/checkpoint.py#L464) warning using `torch.utils.checkpoint.checkpoint` without `use_reentrant` should raise an exception starting from version 2.5

If it's ok, I can either fix warning to say "raise in future version" or replace warning with an exception

cc @soulitzer
